primary_result.statement: With completed curved-shell coefficient A=(C_T/4)K, independent hub density cap m, and L-marginal cap M_L, Q=2HL+2bLP+V^2+alpha L^2+beta L+gamma_0 satisfies ||p_Q||_essinf <= m M_L[2+sqrt(2)+log_+(C_T^2 K^2/(32|b|m^2 M_L^3))], provided the curved shell estimate is available below r_+=1/(2M_L).
primary_result.mechanism: geometric small-shell sum + exact middle-annulus integral of the hub slope against p_L(l)/|l| + large-L hub slope

target_valid_corollary.family: Q_b=2HL+2bLP+V^2, with H an independent cap-one original coordinate and (L,P,V) simultaneous orthonormal projections of one cap-one product bank
target_valid_corollary.near_coloop_interpretation: O(1+log(1/rho)) where rho=b^2/(1+b^2), improving the previous rho^(-1/6) interface loss on this canonical branch

partner_applied: fleet02/B05 auto11d completed curved-shell theorem applied to the actual shell event P(Q in I, r<=|L|<=2r)<=A|I|sqrt(r/|b|)
concurrency_reconciliation: fleet02/B05 auto11e independently found a qualitative logarithmic bridge; this run sharpens the plateau step by direct annulus integration and does not claim priority for the qualitative logarithmic observation
